review_text_raw: I actually quite liked this one. I quite enjoyed the story, but I do think people are probably right when they say that there is a LOT of reading. Like I said, though, story is good so that kinda helps on the lore front. I thought that the twist about what the main antagonist was was clever and played with the idea of a simulacrum quite well. I would say it was worth ten dollars.
